---
title: "Strengthening the Architecture for High-Quality Universal Pre-K"
description: "A research-practice partnership studying how New York City's Pre-K for All system supports teachers and children's school readiness."
toc: true
---

New York City's Pre-K for All is one of the largest universal pre-K systems in the country. In partnership with the NYC Public Schools Division of Early Childhood Education, this project studies how the system's professional learning and instructional programs, including the *Create* arts integration program, shape teacher practice and children's school readiness, and what supports their implementation at scale.

**Partner:** New York City Public Schools Division of Early Childhood Education\
**Team:** NYU Institute of Human Development and Social Change (PIs: Pamela Morris-Perez, Rachel Abenavoli, and Elise Cappella)\
**Role:** Graduate Assistant, December 2022–present
